original: All right then, let's find a place\nto rest!
There! There's a normal building!\nThere's gotta be people there!
No one would live in a forest like\nthis.
I'm sure they're there! Let's go!
A building, here of all places...
You're right! But why's there a\npicture of an angel?
There can't be any bad Digimon in\na place with a picture of a pretty\nangel!
I guess it can't be helped.
Let's take a good look around this\nplace.
I smell food...and it's a feast!
I smell food...and it's a feast!
I smell food...and it's a feast!
You're right! A whole feast right\nhere...
No matter how you look at it, it's\na bit too good to be true.
It's like some sin, eatin'\ndelicious food like this!
I'll eat some, too! I'd like to be\nlucky, just once in a while!
And Taichi and his friends stuffed\nthemselves.
My stomach's so full, I don't\nthink I can eat any more...
We were *supposed* to be at summer\ncamp, but then...
Yeah, we left home thinking we'd\nbe going to summer camp.
We've been lost in this world for\nfive days. The school and town\nassociation must be in an uproar.
We're all worried about home. I\nam, too...
We have to hang in there for now!
Don't complain about it, Sora. For\nnow, we have to hang in there!
Let's sleep for now and think\nabout it tomorrow!
It's around bedtime. Aren't we all\ntired?
We'll all be able to go home,\nright...?
Crying won't do anything. Cheer up!
Even Yamato gets discouraged\nsometimes, but he tries hard not\nto show it!
Yeah. So if you want to help him,\nthen smile for his sake!
Everyone gets discouraged once in\na while, so I'll give it my all!
I didn't want to get everyone\ndepressed, but...
Talk some more with everyone else
They're sleeping. They fell into\nthis trap so easily.
P-O-O-P! I gotta use the bathroom.
Got it, got it! Can't be helped.
*yawn* Let's hurry up, find the\nbathroom, and go back to bed.
Ugh! I can't hold it in much\nlonger!
Ahaha...I don't know why, but my\nstomach still feels empty.
Ugh! I can't hold it in much\nlonger!
Why don't you just go to the\nbathroom by yourself?
I'm sure even *you're* too scared\nto go to the bathroom at night.
What's a fifth grader? Taichi, you\nuse too many hard words.
Ah! Taichi, did you just hear\nsomething?
Huh? No, nothing out of the\nordinary.
I thought I heard someone\nwhispering over there, but...
Come on, it must be your\nimagination.
But I'm sure I heard a voice.
You're scared to go to the\nbathroom, now you're saying there\nare ghosts...
Good, just in time! Don't go back\nby yourself, okay Taichi?
It's weird, I ate so much, so I\nthought there'd be a lot.
I can't do anything but fart.
We have to hurry up and get back\nto the others!
It would have been better if you'd\njust slept quietly.
It's Devimon! He's the strongest,\nmost evil Digimon!
W-what's going on?!\nThe mansion crumbled, just like\nthat...
You can think of this as the end.\nWhat begins now is a nightmare...
What's going on?! What on earth?
What?! Bring everyone back!\nAgumon! We have to defeat Devimon!
It's weird...I ate so much, but I\ndon't have any power.
Of course. The food and the bath\nwere all illusions.
Why are you doing this to us?
I've covered the entire island in\nblack gears. Next will be the land\nacross the sea!
The other side of the sea? There's\nmore land beyond this island?!
You kids will never live to see\nit, because this will be your\ngrave!
Agumon! How are we gonna stop\nLeomon?
The evil has been purged! So you\nguys are the Chosen Children?!
Again with the whole Chosen\nChildren thing...
Devimon! You'll pay for using\nthose dirty tricks on me!
You were summoned to this world as\nour only hope, so you must live!\nFist of the Beast King!
summoned to this world as our only\nhope, so you must live!\nFist of the Beast King!
Oh, well...I'll kill them off\nslowly, one by one.
Hey, Taichi...where are Yamato and\nGabumon and all the others?
I don't know...but they must be\nsafe somewhere, like us.
